findings.problem: "ce champ" refers to the message box, but this fr corpus calls that surface "zone de saisie" (ui.agents.config.status.attached: "elle est toujours dans la zone de saisie" for EN "it is still in the box"; ui.agents.config.banner.unavailable: "la zone de saisie est donc indisponible" for EN "the composer is unavailable") and reserves "champ" for the secret field of this very flow (6 values: ui.chat.composer.secret_confirm_sending, secret_confirm_put, secret_fill_locked, secret_fill_changed, secret_fill_refused, secret_fill_unavailable use "le champ secret"). In a notice that first sends the reader to the asks panel, "ce champ" can be read as that secret field, which is not the paused surface. Meaning is still recoverable from the second clause ("votre brouillon est conservé"), so this is not a meaning break.
findings.suggestion: "ce champ" -> "cette zone de saisie": "Répondez à la demande de secret dans le panneau des demandes — cette zone de saisie reste en pause jusqu'à votre réponse, et votre brouillon est conservé."
